# Add a position. "ok" is what must hold; "BUG" is a bug back.

## F7: + Add a position on a recipe draft, a mode that needs inbound staging
ok   the row is added with the mode picked
ok   its inbound source and destination come from the routing set
ok   its inbound staging comes from the routing set too (STG_1, the first staging row)

## F5/F33: the recipe draft's bar, on a routing set with no staging row
ok   an untouched draft says "No unsaved changes"
ok   a required cell left empty is "1 to fix" on the bar
ok   the bar never says "Preview OK" over a recipe draft
ok   Save recipe… is disabled while it is
ok   and the bar says "Unsaved changes" now

## F4: Back on a recipe draft
ok   an untouched draft leaves without asking
ok   a changed draft asks before it is discarded
#    asked: "Discard this recipe draft?" [Keep editing · Discard]
ok   Keep editing keeps the draft and its row
ok   Discard leaves the draft

## F3: the required inbound staging chip, with no staging row and no back position
#    the popover: "Add and use · Staging GRP_A DST_1 DST_2 DST_9 NEW_1 NEW_2 NEW_3 OTH_1 POS_B1 POS_B2 POS_B3 POS_B4 SHR_1 SRC_1 SRC_2 SRC_A1 SRC_A2 STG_1 STG_2 STG_3 STG_9"
ok   the popover offers places from the plant to add and use
#    picked STG_9: POST /api/processes/1/routing-nodes {"core_node_name":"STG_9","role":"staging","label":"STG_9","enabled":true,"sequence":1}
ok   Add and use is one request: the routing set gains it for staging
ok   and the row uses it

## F36: Settings › HMI setup on a process with no recipe
#    "HMI setup off: the operator changes over to a style an engineer made · on: they may set a style up — pick a part and a recipe, and move its spots For a cell bei"
ok   the HMI setup row says the process has no recipe
ok   and offers New recipe there
ok   "Found in your flows" is beside it

## Press A with Recipe One
rail headings: ["Recipes · 1","Styles · 2"] · + New recipe drawn
rail foot: "+ New style a part this process runs"
main: "Style A Index Swap + 2‑Robot Swap + 1‑Robot Swap + Sequential A/B · 10 positions · last run 11-10 running" · buttons ["+ New recipe","+ New style","Discard changes","Save as recipe…","Use a recipe ▾","Save style","+ Add a position"]
New style: "New style — a part this process runs: name it, then draw its flow." · fields ["Start from a recipe","Name","Expected CATID"]
  the chooser opens on "— none, draw it —" (value "")

## Press A with no recipe
rail headings: ["Styles · 2"] · + New recipe not drawn
rail foot: "+ New style a part this process runs"
main: "Style A Index Swap + 2‑Robot Swap + 1‑Robot Swap + Sequential A/B · 10 positions · last run 11-10 running" · buttons ["+ New style","Discard changes","Save as recipe…","Save style","+ Add a position"]
New style: "New style — a part this process runs: name it, then draw its flow." · fields ["Name","Expected CATID"]

## Press A with no style and no recipe
rail headings: [] · + New recipe not drawn
rail foot: ""
main: "" · buttons ["Change…","Change…","+ New style","Set up…","New recipe"]
New style: "New style — a part this process runs: name it, then draw its flow." · fields ["Name","Expected CATID"]

## the Setup tab: Press A opened at each state (tabs, then the rows: value → action)
# a new process: nothing yet · lands on setup · tabs ["Setup*","Styles","Operator screens","Settings"]
  · positions: "none yet" → Add positions [primary]
  · routing: "none yet" → Set the routing set
  · style: "none yet" → + New style
  · screen: "Screen A · not run yet" → Open the screen
  · counter: "counting on PLC_A · CountA" → Set up…
  · hmi: "off · no recipe yet" → New recipe
# positions claimed · lands on setup · tabs ["Setup*","Styles","Operator screens","Settings"]
  ✓ positions: "POS_A1 · POS_A2 · POS_A3 · +13" → Change…
  · routing: "none yet" → Set the routing set [primary]
  · style: "none yet" → + New style
  · screen: "Screen A · not run yet" → Open the screen
  · counter: "counting on PLC_A · CountA" → Set up…
  · hmi: "off · no recipe yet" → New recipe
# and a routing set · lands on setup · tabs ["Setup*","Styles","Operator screens","Settings"]
  ✓ positions: "POS_A1 · POS_A2 · POS_A3 · +13" → Change…
  ✓ routing: "2 sources · 3 staging · 2 destinations" → Change…
  · style: "none yet" → + New style [primary]
  · screen: "Screen A · not run yet" → Open the screen
  · counter: "counting on PLC_A · CountA" → Set up…
  · hmi: "off · no recipe yet" → New recipe
# and a style with no flow yet · lands on setup · tabs ["Setup*","Styles","Operator screens","Settings"]
  ✓ positions: "POS_A1 · POS_A2 · POS_A3 · +13" → Change…
  ✓ routing: "2 sources · 3 staging · 2 destinations" → Change…
  · style: "Style A · no flow yet" → Draw its flow [primary]
  · screen: "Screen A · not run yet" → Open the screen
  · counter: "counting on PLC_A · CountA" → Set up…
  · hmi: "off · no recipe yet" → New recipe
# and its flow drawn, never run · lands on setup · tabs ["Setup*","Styles","Operator screens","Settings"]
  ✓ positions: "POS_A1 · POS_A2 · POS_A3 · +13" → Change…
  ✓ routing: "2 sources · 3 staging · 2 destinations" → Change…
  ✓ style: "Style A · +1" → Open
  · screen: "Screen A · not run yet" → Open the screen [primary]
  · counter: "counting on PLC_A · CountA" → Set up…
  · hmi: "off · 1 recipe" → Change…
# run once (active style set) · lands on flows · tabs ["Styles*","Operator screens","Settings"]
# HMI setup on with no recipe, never run · lands on setup
  · counter: "counting on PLC_A · CountA" → Set up…
  · hmi: "on · no recipe yet" (warn) → New recipe

## where a #tab= link lands (the Recipes tab went to HMI setup on Settings)
  #tab=presets → tab settings · tabs ["Styles","Operator screens","Settings*"] · the recipes beside HMI setup · hash "?process=1#tab=settings"
  #tab=recipes → tab settings · tabs ["Styles","Operator screens","Settings*"] · the recipes beside HMI setup · hash "?process=1#tab=settings"
  #tab=presets;preset=7 → tab settings · tabs ["Styles","Operator screens","Settings*"] · the recipes beside HMI setup · Recipe One expanded · hash "?process=1#tab=settings"
  #tab=settings → tab settings · tabs ["Styles","Operator screens","Settings*"] · the recipes beside HMI setup · hash "?process=1#tab=settings"
  #tab=setup → tab flows · tabs ["Styles*","Operator screens","Settings"] · hash "?process=1#style=1"
  Settings › HMI setup: "id=\"pd-hmirecipes\"> Recipes what an operator sets a style up from 1 recipe New recipe Name Shape Applied to Drift Saved Recipe One v1 mixed 0 parts in step — Apply to parts… ⋯ Parts this process runs the operator’s part "

## the Setup tab's actions, from a new process with positions (each on a fresh page)
  positions → tab setup, sheet "Add positions" · GET /api/core-nodes, GET /api/process-nodes
  routing → tab settings · GET …/routing-nodes, GET /api/process-nodes, GET /api/payload-catalog, GET …/payloads, GET …/station-counters, GET …/counting-slots, GET …/catid-health, GET …/presets, GET /api/core-nodes
  style → tab setup, sheet "New style" · GET /api/core-nodes
  counter → tab settings · GET …/routing-nodes, GET /api/process-nodes, GET /api/payload-catalog, GET …/payloads, GET …/station-counters, GET …/counting-slots, GET …/catid-health, GET …/presets, GET /api/core-nodes
  hmi → tab flows (a recipe draft) · GET …/composer
